title: CampaignPolicy
description: Defines the constraints, budget, and rules governing a research campaign. The policy engine enforces these — the planner cannot silently override them.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign this policy governs

max_database_queries.description: Maximum database API calls (UniProt, PDB, ChEMBL)

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock time for the campaign

evidence_requirements.description: Minimum evidence thresholds before state transitions

min_evidence_for_support.description: Minimum pieces of evidence to mark a hypothesis as supported

min_confidence_for_support.description: Minimum confidence to transition hypothesis to supported

require_contradiction_search.description: Whether the critic must search for contradictory evidence

require_literature_evidence.description: Whether at least one literature source is required per hypothesis

tool_permissions.description: Which tools the agent may use

allowed_tools.description: Whitelist of allowed tools (null = all allowed)

forbidden_tools.description: Blacklist of forbidden tools (null = none forbidden)

stopping_criteria.description: Conditions under which the campaign should stop

confidence_threshold.description: Stop when all hypotheses exceed this confidence

stop_on_all_resolved.description: Stop when all hypotheses are supported, refuted, or inconclusive

stop_on_budget_exhausted.description: Stop when any budget limit is reached

stop_on_no_improvement.description: Stop if an iteration produces no confidence improvement

min_improvement_delta.description: Minimum confidence improvement to justify another iteration

approval_gates.description: Which decision points require human approval

require_re_plan_approval.description: Whether to require approval when the agent re-plans

scientific_constraints.description: Hard scientific rules that cannot be overridden

never_claim_predictions_as_facts.description: IMMUTABLE: Computational predictions must never be presented as validated results

require_provenance.description: IMMUTABLE: Every claim must have a traceable source

require_evidence_typing.description: IMMUTABLE: Every evidence piece must be classified by source type

require_uncertainty_labels.description: IMMUTABLE: Uncertain results must be labeled as such
